# Price the wait, not just the work.

> Calculate invoice due dates, when cash actually lands on your client's payment run, late-fee scenarios, cash-flow exposure, whether a 2/10 Net 30 discount still beats waiting, and whether factoring still beats waiting after your carrying cost.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
